title: Date jump (getChatMessageByDate) answer is matched by purpose; DateJumpAnswer holds no RequestId
trigger: Pick date A in the Jump to date box, then date B before A's getChatMessageByDate answers; both answers go through accept_date_message/fail_date_jump with only the purpose checked
effect: The later-arriving answer overwrites search.date_jump, so a stale day can win over the newest pick (the driver consumes each Resolved jump in arrival order)
fix: DateJumpAnswer::Asking{request} set when the request is sent; apply/fail only when pending.id equals it

title: resetNetworkStatistics ok rewrites an in-flight network fetch to Loading{request:None}, then the pre-reset answer lands through the unmatched succeed
trigger: Open Network usage (getNetworkStatistics in flight), reset the usage, and the reset ok arrives before the fetch answer
effect: The stage holds no request, so the old fetch answer is applied by Fetch::succeed (no request check) and the panel shows the numbers from before the reset until it is reopened
fix: On reset call network.begin()/sent(new request) for a refetch (or drop to Idle and cancel the old request) so only the post-reset answer is matched by RequestId

title: Submit::Sending reads a failure only while the registry still remembers it; an evicted failure reads Done
trigger: A box sends Save; the request fails but the box is not polled until 64 other requests failed after it (FAILURES_KEPT), e.g. a hidden/background window.
effect: view() finds no failure and no pending request, so it returns SubmitView::Done and the box closes as if saved, losing the typed form and the error.
fix: Have the answer/error path settle the owning Submit (or keep failures until their Submit reads them) instead of inferring Done from absence in the registry.

title: StickerSelection keeps set_id and stage.set_id in step by hand
trigger: selection.set_id is assigned separately from stage; selected_needs_load compares the two to decide whether to ask.
effect: No bug today; a code path that sets one without the other either never loads or loads again.
fix: Make the stage the only holder of the set id (Idle becomes Selected{set_id} before the ask).

title: AttachedStickers is a dead duplicate of AttachedSets
trigger: grep finds no use of AttachedStickers outside its definition; the box uses AttachedSets.
effect: Two enums with the same stages and different method names; a reader may extend the unused one.
fix: Delete AttachedStickers (and give AttachedSets the matched answered/failed methods it has here).
